# Project Lighthouse (v1)

**⚠️ Superseded — see [[entity-Project-Lighthouse-v2]].**

Harbor sensor platform for the Port of Callowmere. Three buoys with a
proprietary 900MHz radio link back to the pier station. Deployed at kickoff;
plagued by CRC errors near pier 7.
